summaries.name: University of California, Berkeley
summaries.summary: University of California, Berkeley is hosting the user for a semester abroad exchange program; the user submitted their application on February 10th and was accepted on March 20th, 2023. The user booked a flight to San Francisco on April 1st, departing August 15th, and had a US embassy visa interview on April 25th. UC Berkeley requires international students to carry health insurance covering at least $100,000 in medical expenses, $25,000 for repatriation, and $50,000 for medical evacuation, and offers a Student Health Insurance Plan (SHIP) that meets these requirements. The university provides an International Student Orientation, a Cal ID and student email, Student Union, Recreational Sports Facility, and Tang Center for health and counseling, plus English Language Support Services (ELSS) and the Berkeley English Language Proficiency Requirement (BEPR). The user plans to join the UC Berkeley Photography Club and volunteer at a local animal shelter.

summaries.name: CBP Form 6059B
summaries.summary: CBP Form 6059B is the Customs Declaration Form that international travelers receive before landing in the US and must complete accurately and keep with their passport upon arrival.

summaries.name: ESTA
summaries.summary: ESTA (Electronic System for Travel Authorization) is an approval required for travelers from visa-waiver countries entering the US, serving as an alternative to an F-1 student visa; the approval must be kept readily available along with flight booking confirmation.
